issues.title: Mission 3 (Flooded Market): ammo runs out halfway through after 2.1, causing a spike in deaths and restarts and a drop in completion

ticket.title: Mission 3 (Flooded Market): ammo runs out halfway through after 2.1, causing a spike in deaths and restarts and a drop in completion
ticket.summary: After patch 2.1, nine distinct players report that Flooded Market (mission 3) has far too little ammo and that it runs out around the midpoint (B004, B008, B017, B040). Telemetry shows completion falling from 82% to 64%, deaths/player rising from 3 to 5.7 and restarts from 1.4 to 2.3, with an estimated 801 players lost. Error reports are unchanged at 4, so this looks like a balance problem rather than a crash.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Loot table rebalance" - players consistently say ammo drops in Flooded Market became too low after 2.1 (B040, B017, B019 'the ammo nerf went too far'), which matches a change to loot table drop rates.
repro_steps: Install patch 2.1 and start mission 3 (Flooded Market), solo or in a co-op party.
Play from the start of the mission and fight normally, collecting ammo drops from enemies and containers.
Track ammo reserves and the number of ammo pickups as you progress toward the middle of the mission.
Observe that ammo is depleted around the halfway point (B008, B017, B040).
Continue through the second half with little or no ammo and note the deaths and restarts (B012, B060).
Compare ammo drop frequency against the pre-2.1 build (loot tables).

ticket.title: Mission 5 (Cargo Lift): second co-op player desyncs and disconnects when the lift moves, since Patch 2.1
ticket.summary: Since 2.1, the partner in co-op desyncs and is dropped from the session on the Cargo Lift in mission 5 (B003, B062, B030). Telemetry shows completion falling from 84% to 58%, restarts rising from 1.2 to 2.1 and error reports jumping from 9 to 388, while deaths/player stay flat at 1.6, so this is a connection fault rather than a difficulty problem. Ten distinct players reported it, with an estimated 587 players lost.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Netcode improvements for moving platforms" - the Cargo Lift is a moving platform, and the disconnects begin as soon as it moves (B030) or when a player steps onto it (B043), which suggests the netcode change introduced a desync on moving platforms.
repro_steps: Start a co-op session of at least 2 players on Patch 2.1 and load mission 5 (Cargo Lift).
Progress to the cargo lift/elevator with both players (B027, B066).
Have the second player step onto the lift (B043).
Activate the lift so it starts moving (B030).
Observe the second player desync and get disconnected or kicked from the session (B062, B003, B025).

ticket.title: Mission 7 (Harbor Master): required key does not spawn after the cutscene, soft-locking the mission and collapsing completion from 76% to 19%
ticket.summary: Since patch 2.1, the Harbor Master key needed to open the door/gate in Mission 7 does not spawn, so players cannot progress (B007, B036, B050, B055). Telemetry shows completion falling from 76% to 19% and restarts rising from 1.3 to 3.4 while deaths/player is flat (1.9 → 1.8), which points to a progression blocker rather than a difficulty spike. An estimated 482 players are lost, and 10 distinct players reported it.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Mission scripting fixes" - the key spawn is likely triggered by mission script logic after the cutscene (B054, B055), and a change to that scripting may have broken or skipped the spawn event. This is an inference from the patch notes and reports, not confirmed.
repro_steps: Start Mission 7 (Harbor Master).
Play through to the cutscene that precedes the key objective (B054, B055).
After the cutscene ends, look for the Harbor Master's key; it does not appear (B050, B059).
Try to open the locked door/gate; it stays locked (B036, B050).
Reload or restart the mission and repeat; the key still does not spawn (B037).

Launch Mission 4 (Lighthouse).
Press the remapped flashlight key and observe that the flashlight does not turn on (B042, B048).
Reset all bindings to default (B057) or use the default flashlight key (B014, B065) and observe that the flashlight works.
